However, there is no evidence provided for cloud platforms (AWS), container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, leadership experience, or quantified business impact on revenue.
recommendations: If you have experience deploying applications to AWS, include specific AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) in your resume.
Highlight any exposure to container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes or ECS.
Add details regarding CI/CD pipeline usage (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) if applicable to your previous development workflows.
If applicable, document any technical leadership, mentorship, or project lead responsibilities to address leadership requirements.
